infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: BT reads GPS speed while a trip is being recorded, which may continue while the app is in the background, to measure your driving. Your location and routes are never stored.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: BT reads GPS speed while a trip is being recorded, to measure your driving. Your location and routes are never stored.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: BT uses motion sensors to detect driving events like hard braking and sharp turns.
